messages:
maria: Quick proposal — run a short 45min webinar focused on 'Practical patterns for predictable LLM inference at scale' aimed at PMs + infra leads. Short, example-driven. Thoughts?
jorge: love the audience. can we make the hook about cost predictability + fallback strategies? that's what gets exec buy-in. :money_with_wings:
priya: abstract draft: 'How teams ship reliable LLM features: routing, caching, and safe fallbacks.' 3 concrete takeaways + 1 checklist.
sam: speakers: maria (product), jorge (benchmarks/metrics), alex (runtime eng) + 10min customer panel? Elaine from success can recruit.
alex: +1 on runtime demo but keep it pre-recorded 5–7m. live demos are risky with multi-region routing.
elaine: I can ask two customers — one SaaS + one enterprise — to do 10m panel each. will confirm availability by Tue.
maria: run-of-show idea (45m total):
- 0:00 intro + why predictable inference matters (maria, 5m)
- 5:00 customer mini-panel (elaine moderates, 12m)
- 17:00 deep-dive: routing & fallback patterns (jorge, 8m)
- 25:00 demo/video: runtime + observability (alex, 6m)
- 31:00 playbook & checklist (priya, 6m)
- 37:00 live Q&A (all, 8m)
- 45:00 wrap + CTA -> dedicated + private trials (maria)
jorge: sounds tight but doable. propose adding a 2-min buffer after the panel for mics.
priya: draft abstract for the registration page: 'Many teams hit surprising latency or cost cliffs when they scale LLM features. Join Redwood Inference to learn practical design patterns — from autoscaling and fallbacks to batching and KV-caching — that keep your app fast and predictable.'
maria: good. can we also include 3 short bullet takeaways on the page? (i) reduce tail latency; (ii) predictable unit cost; (iii) safe degrade paths.
sam: logistics: rehearse Wed 10am PT (60m). please add to calendars. rehearsal checklist: slides uploaded, demo recording linked, backup slide for demo failure, speaker mics checked.
alex: demo fallback: if live model throws OOM or latency spike, we show pre-recorded clip and switch to a smaller quantized model. ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered snapshot at rehearsal start: success.
elaine: lead routing plan: HubSpot form with hidden fields: source=webinar, product_interest=dedicated|private|hosted. SDR mapping: if product_interest==private -> AE alert + enterprise queue, else -> SDR nurture flow.
priya: include consent checkbox and GDPR copy. also tag registrants by cloud-region (eu/us/apac) for regional follow-up.
jorge: quick HubSpot wf snippet: ```if region==eu and interest==private -> assign to eu-enterprise-queue; if region!=eu and interest==private -> assign to na-enterprise-queue; else -> send to webinar-nurture-sequence```
maria: marketing assets: hero banner, 3 social copy variations, 1 blog post companion. Assignments: sam social, priya blog, alex & jorge tech details.
sam: social schedule: 2 weeks out: save the date, 3 days out: speakers + takeaways, day-of: link + 1-min demo gif. add UTM params: utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=webinar-inference-mar.
elaine: follow-up plan: send recording + 3 resource links within 24h. for enterprise-intent leads, AE reaches out within 48h.
jorge: measurement: target 800 registrants, 300 live, 30 SQLs. track: registration -> attended -> demo-requests. add tracking on registration form for 'primary use case' (chat, summarization, retrieval).
maria: action items:
- priya: finalize landing page copy by Fri EOD
- sam: creative + socials by Mon
- elaine: confirm customers by Tue
- alex: record demo by Tue, upload to drive
- jorge: prepare 3 benchmark slides + fallback diagrams
- all: join Wed rehearsal 10am PT
priya: will drop landing page draft in #marketing-assets in 24h.
sam: adding rehearsal invite now.
elaine: reached out to customer A and customer B. awaiting times.
alex: demo recording scheduled for Mon 3pm PT. will put file in shared drive and link in thread.
maria: thanks team — let's aim to keep slides <20 and emphasize concrete checklists. :rocket:
